title: save customer
content:
1. Navigate to url - https://s-dev-ukg.sandbox.operations.dynamics.com/?cross-company=true&cmp=1001&mi=SalesTableDetails

  2. click on Modules

  3. Click on account receivables

  4. click on all customers

  5. click on new

  6. fill customer account with details "test123"

  7. fill name with details "test"

  8. fill customer group with details "test"

  9. click on save

  10. validate newly created customer
